## 1. Purpose

This module fits the GBLUP-ADE benchmark to the three prepared *Coffea arabica*
traits under the family-stratified repeated outer cross-validation defined in
the real-data validation module.

The primary comparison uses the same 25 outer held-out splits for GBLUP-ADE and
all ANN variants. With three traits, this produces **3 x 25 = 75 primary
trait-by-split fits**.

Four principles define the analysis:

- phenotype values from the outer assessment set are unavailable during fitting;
- genotypes from all 195 individuals can be used to construct genomic
  relationship matrices because genotype information is available at prediction
  time and does not contain held-out phenotype;
- the common 20,887-marker panel prepared upstream is used without additional
  model-specific marker filtering;
- performance is evaluated only from predictions for the 39 held-out
  individuals in each outer split.

The complementary leave-one-family-out design stored upstream is not mixed with
the primary benchmark here. It remains available for a separate generalization
analysis.

## 2. Packages and fixed execution settings

A normal page build reads the saved GBLUP-ADE results. Setting
`RUN_GBLUP=1` activates the complete 75-task fitting workflow and overwrites the
saved GBLUP outputs.

```{r packages, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
RUN_GBLUP <- identical(Sys.getenv("RUN_GBLUP", "0"), "1")

library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggthemes)

if (RUN_GBLUP) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(
    library(sommer)
  )
}
```

```{r fitting-control}
SEED_GLOBAL <- 20261105L
N_ITERS_SOMMER <- 20L

fitting_control <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c(
    "Global seed",
    "Run new GBLUP-ADE fits",
    "sommer iterations per fit"
  ),
  Value = c(
    SEED_GLOBAL,
```

## 3. Canonical inputs

```{r inputs}
common <- readRDS(
  "output/real/audit/preprocessed_real_common.rds"
)

cv <- readRDS(
  "output/real/validation/real_cv_design.rds"
)

geno <- as.matrix(common$genotype)
pheno <- common$phenotype
traits <- common$traits

ids <- rownames(geno)

stopifnot(
  nrow(geno) == 195L,
  ncol(geno) == 20887L,
  identical(ids, pheno$genotipo),
  identical(sort(traits), sort(c("Prod.Cor", "Cer", "BM"))),
  length(cv$outer_splits) == 25L,
  all(is.finite(geno)),
  all(geno %in% c(-1, 0, 1))
)

input_summary <- data.frame(
  Object = c(
    "Genotype matrix",
    "Prepared phenotype",
    "Prediction traits",
    "Primary outer splits"
  ),
  Structure = c(
    paste(dim(geno), collapse = " x "),
    paste(dim(pheno), collapse = " x "),
    paste(traits, collapse = ", "),
    length(cv$outer_splits)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

input_summary |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    caption = "Canonical objects entering GBLUP-ADE",
    row.names = FALSE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-hover table-bordered"'
  )
```

The marker matrix retains the `-1, 0, 1` coding used by the genomic relationship
matrix constructors. Quality control has already been performed upstream, so
the GBLUP branch does not redefine the marker panel.

## 4. Statistical benchmark

For each trait and outer split,

\[
\mathbf{y} = \mathbf{1}\mu + \mathbf{a} + \mathbf{d} + \mathbf{e} +
\boldsymbol{\varepsilon},
\]

with

\[
\mathbf{a}\sim N(0,\mathbf{A}\sigma_a^2),\qquad
\mathbf{d}\sim N(0,\mathbf{D}\sigma_d^2),
\]

\[
\mathbf{e}\sim N(0,\mathbf{E}\sigma_e^2),\qquad
\boldsymbol{\varepsilon}\sim N(0,\mathbf{I}\sigma_\varepsilon^2).
\]

The total predicted genomic component is

\[
\widehat{G}=\widehat{a}+\widehat{d}+\widehat{e},
\]

and the held-out prediction is

\[
\widehat{y}=\widehat{\mu}+\widehat{G}.
\]

The historical field name `GEBV` is retained in saved predictions for
compatibility with the simulated workflow, but here it represents the summed
additive, dominance, and additive-by-additive epistatic prediction rather than
an additive-only breeding value.

## 5. Primary trait-by-split workload

```{r task-table}
outer_meta <- unique(
  cv$outer_assignments[
    , c("Repetition", "OuterFold", "SplitID")
  ]
)

outer_meta <- outer_meta[
  order(
    outer_meta$Repetition,
    outer_meta$OuterFold
  ),
]

task_table <- merge(
  data.frame(
    Trait = traits,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  outer_meta,
  by = NULL
)

task_table <- task_table[
  order(
    match(task_table$Trait, traits),
    task_table$Repetition,
    task_table$OuterFold
  ),
]

task_table$TaskID <- paste(
  task_table$Trait,
  task_table$SplitID,
  sep = "_"
)

rownames(task_table) <- NULL

stopifnot(
  nrow(task_table) == 75L,
  length(unique(task_table$TaskID)) == 75L
)

head(task_table, 15) |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    caption = "First 15 of the 75 primary GBLUP-ADE tasks",
    row.names = FALSE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-hover table-bordered"'
  )
```

## 6. Evaluation metrics

Performance is calculated only in the outer assessment set. The stored metrics
are:

- Pearson correlation;
- RMSE;
- MAE;
- bias, defined as `mean(predicted - observed)`;
- calibration slope from `observed ~ predicted`;
- predictive \(R^2 = 1 - SSE/SST\).

The 25 split-level values per trait are descriptive repeated-cross-validation
results; they are not treated as statistically independent replicates.

## 7. Complete GBLUP-ADE fitting workflow

The three genomic relationship matrices are constructed once from the common
20,887-marker matrix and reused across all 75 tasks. For each task, the 39 outer
assessment phenotypes are replaced by `NA` before fitting.

```{r fit-gblup-ade, eval=RUN_GBLUP}
set.seed(SEED_GLOBAL)

run_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]

kernel_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]

A_matrix <- sommer::A.mat(
  geno,
  min.MAF = 0
)

D_matrix <- sommer::D.mat(
  geno,
  nishio = TRUE,
  min.MAF = 0
)

E_matrix <- sommer::E.mat(
  geno,
  nishio = TRUE,
  type = "A#A",
  min.MAF = 0
)

kernel_seconds <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - kernel_start

rownames(A_matrix) <- colnames(A_matrix) <- ids
rownames(D_matrix) <- colnames(D_matrix) <- ids
rownames(E_matrix) <- colnames(E_matrix) <- ids

kernel_summary <- data.frame(
  Kernel = c("Additive", "Dominance", "Epistatic_AxA"),
  Rows = c(nrow(A_matrix), nrow(D_matrix), nrow(E_matrix)),
  Columns = c(ncol(A_matrix), ncol(D_matrix), ncol(E_matrix)),
  Symmetric = c(
    isTRUE(all.equal(A_matrix, t(A_matrix), tolerance = 1e-8)),
    isTRUE(all.equal(D_matrix, t(D_matrix), tolerance = 1e-8)),
    isTRUE(all.equal(E_matrix, t(E_matrix), tolerance = 1e-8))
  ),
  Finite = c(
    all(is.finite(A_matrix)),
    all(is.finite(D_matrix)),
    all(is.finite(E_matrix))
  ),
  Mean_diagonal = c(
    mean(diag(A_matrix)),
    mean(diag(D_matrix)),
    mean(diag(E_matrix))
  ),
  Kernel_build_seconds = rep(kernel_seconds, 3L),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stopifnot(
  all(kernel_summary$Rows == 195L),
  all(kernel_summary$Columns == 195L),
  all(kernel_summary$Symmetric),
  all(kernel_summary$Finite)
)

result_list <- vector("list", nrow(task_table))
prediction_list <- vector("list", nrow(task_table))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(task_table))) {

  task <- task_table[i, ]
  trait <- task$Trait
  split <- cv$outer_splits[[task$SplitID]]

  analysis_index <- match(
    split$analysis_ids,
    ids
  )

  assessment_index <- match(
    split$assessment_ids,
    ids
  )

  stopifnot(
    length(analysis_index) == 156L,
    length(assessment_index) == 39L,
    !anyNA(analysis_index),
    !anyNA(assessment_index),
    length(intersect(analysis_index, assessment_index)) == 0L
  )

  phenotype_vector <- pheno[[trait]]

  id_factor <- factor(
    ids,
    levels = ids
  )

  dat <- data.frame(
    y = phenotype_vector,
    id = id_factor,
    idd = id_factor,
    ide = id_factor
  )

  dat$y[assessment_index] <- NA_real_

  fit_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]

  task_result <- tryCatch(
    {

      fit <- sommer::mmes(
        y ~ 1,
        random = ~
          vsm(ism(id),  Gu = A_matrix) +
          vsm(ism(idd), Gu = D_matrix) +
          vsm(ism(ide), Gu = E_matrix),
        rcov = ~ units,
        nIters = N_ITERS_SOMMER,
        data = dat,
        verbose = FALSE,
        dateWarning = FALSE
      )

      fit_seconds <-
        proc.time()[["elapsed"]] -
        fit_start

      prediction_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]

      stopifnot(length(fit$uList) >= 3L)

      additive_effect <- as.matrix(
        fit$uList[[1L]]
      )

      dominance_effect <- as.matrix(
        fit$uList[[2L]]
      )

      epistatic_effect <- as.matrix(
        fit$uList[[3L]]
      )

      additive_incidence <- model.matrix(
        ~ id - 1,
        data = dat
      )

      dominance_incidence <- model.matrix(
        ~ idd - 1,
        data = dat
      )

      epistatic_incidence <- model.matrix(
        ~ ide - 1,
        data = dat
      )

      additive <- as.numeric(
        additive_incidence %*%
          additive_effect[, 1L, drop = FALSE]
      )

      dominance <- as.numeric(
        dominance_incidence %*%
          dominance_effect[, 1L, drop = FALSE]
      )

      epistatic <- as.numeric(
        epistatic_incidence %*%
          epistatic_effect[, 1L, drop = FALSE]
      )

      genomic_component <-
        additive +
        dominance +
        epistatic

      intercept <- as.numeric(fit$b)[1L]

      predicted_value <-
        intercept +
        genomic_component

      predict_seconds <-
        proc.time()[["elapsed"]] -
        prediction_start

      observed_test <- phenotype_vector[
        assessment_index
      ]

      predicted_test <- predicted_value[
        assessment_index
      ]

      genomic_component_test <- genomic_component[
        assessment_index
      ]

      if (
        length(unique(observed_test)) > 1L &&
        length(unique(predicted_test)) > 1L
      ) {
        correlation <- cor(
          predicted_test,
          observed_test
        )
      } else {
        correlation <- NA_real_
      }

      rmse <- sqrt(
        mean(
          (predicted_test - observed_test)^2
        )
      )

      mae <- mean(
        abs(
          predicted_test - observed_test
        )
      )

      bias <- mean(
        predicted_test - observed_test
      )

      if (length(unique(predicted_test)) > 1L) {
        slope <- as.numeric(
          coef(
            lm(
              observed_test ~ predicted_test
            )
          )[2L]
        )
      } else {
        slope <- NA_real_
      }

      sst <- sum(
        (observed_test - mean(observed_test))^2
      )

      if (sst > 0) {
        r2 <- 1 -
          sum(
            (observed_test - predicted_test)^2
          ) / sst
      } else {
        r2 <- NA_real_
      }

      list(
        result = data.frame(
          Dataset = "real",
          Trait = trait,
          Repetition = task$Repetition,
          Fold = task$OuterFold,
          SplitID = task$SplitID,
          TaskID = task$TaskID,
          Model = "GBLUP_ADE",
          N_train = length(analysis_index),
          N_test = length(assessment_index),
          N_pred_finite = sum(is.finite(predicted_test)),
          Phenotype_Correlation = correlation,
          Phenotype_RMSE = rmse,
          Phenotype_MAE = mae,
          Phenotype_Bias = bias,
          Phenotype_Slope = slope,
          Phenotype_R2 = r2,
          Kernel_build_seconds = kernel_seconds,
          Fit_seconds = fit_seconds,
          Predict_seconds = predict_seconds,
          Status = if (
            all(is.finite(predicted_test))
          ) "ok" else "nonfinite_prediction",
          Error = NA_character_,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        ),
        prediction = data.frame(
          Dataset = "real",
          Trait = trait,
          Repetition = task$Repetition,
          Fold = task$OuterFold,
          SplitID = task$SplitID,
          TaskID = task$TaskID,
          Model = "GBLUP_ADE",
          ID = ids[assessment_index],
          Family = common$family[
            ids[assessment_index]
          ],
          Observed_Phenotype = observed_test,
          Predicted_Value = predicted_test,
          GEBV = genomic_component_test,
          Additive_Prediction = additive[
            assessment_index
          ],
          Dominance_Prediction = dominance[
            assessment_index
          ],
          Epistatic_Prediction = epistatic[
            assessment_index
          ],
          Status = if (
            all(is.finite(predicted_test))
          ) "ok" else "nonfinite_prediction",
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {

      fit_seconds <-
        proc.time()[["elapsed"]] -
        fit_start

      list(
        result = data.frame(
          Dataset = "real",
          Trait = trait,
          Repetition = task$Repetition,
          Fold = task$OuterFold,
          SplitID = task$SplitID,
          TaskID = task$TaskID,
          Model = "GBLUP_ADE",
          N_train = length(analysis_index),
          N_test = length(assessment_index),
          N_pred_finite = 0L,
          Phenotype_Correlation = NA_real_,
          Phenotype_RMSE = NA_real_,
          Phenotype_MAE = NA_real_,
          Phenotype_Bias = NA_real_,
          Phenotype_Slope = NA_real_,
          Phenotype_R2 = NA_real_,
          Kernel_build_seconds = kernel_seconds,
          Fit_seconds = fit_seconds,
          Predict_seconds = NA_real_,
          Status = "error",
          Error = conditionMessage(e),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        ),
        prediction = NULL
      )
    }
  )

  result_list[[i]] <- task_result$result
  prediction_list[[i]] <- task_result$prediction

  cat(
    sprintf(
      "[%02d/%02d] %s | status=%s | r=%s | RMSE=%s\n",
      i,
      nrow(task_table),
      task$TaskID,
      task_result$result$Status,
      ifelse(
        is.finite(
          task_result$result$Phenotype_Correlation
        ),
        sprintf(
          "%.4f",
          task_result$result$Phenotype_Correlation
        ),
        "NA"
      ),
      ifelse(
        is.finite(
          task_result$result$Phenotype_RMSE
        ),
        sprintf(
          "%.4f",
          task_result$result$Phenotype_RMSE
        ),
        "NA"
      )
    )
  )
}

results <- do.call(
  rbind,
  result_list
)

prediction_list <- Filter(
  Negate(is.null),
  prediction_list
)

if (length(prediction_list) > 0L) {
  predictions <- do.call(
    rbind,
    prediction_list
  )
} else {
  predictions <- data.frame()
}

rownames(results) <- NULL
rownames(predictions) <- NULL

run_seconds <-
  proc.time()[["elapsed"]] -
  run_start

run_metadata <- list(
  dataset = "real",
  model = "GBLUP_ADE",
  seed_global = SEED_GLOBAL,
  sommer_version = as.character(
    packageVersion("sommer")
  ),
  nIters_sommer = N_ITERS_SOMMER,
  marker_panel_n = ncol(geno),
  individuals_n = nrow(geno),
  traits = traits,
  outer_splits = length(cv$outer_splits),
  tasks_expected = nrow(task_table),
  tasks_ok = sum(results$Status == "ok"),
  tasks_error = sum(results$Status == "error"),
  prediction_rows = nrow(predictions),
  kernel_build_seconds = kernel_seconds,
  total_run_seconds = run_seconds,
  timestamp = as.character(Sys.time())
)
```

## 8. Saved-run availability

```{r saved-output-contract}
result_path <-
  "output/real/gblup/real_gblup_ade_results.rds"

prediction_path <-
  "output/real/gblup/real_gblup_ade_predictions.rds"

metadata_path <-
  "output/real/gblup/real_gblup_ade_run_metadata.rds"

kernel_path <-
  "output/real/gblup/real_gblup_ade_kernel_summary.csv"

saved_outputs_available <- all(
  file.exists(
    c(
      result_path,
      prediction_path,
      metadata_path,
      kernel_path
    )
  )
)

if (!saved_outputs_available) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Saved GBLUP-ADE outputs are not available.",
      "Run this module once with RUN_GBLUP=1."
    )
  )
}
```

## 10. Saved results and primary predictive performance

```{r saved-results}
results <- readRDS(
  result_path
)

predictions <- readRDS(
  prediction_path
)

run_metadata <- readRDS(
  metadata_path
)

result_structure <- data.frame(
  Quantity = c(
    "Expected tasks",
    "Stored task rows",
    "Successful tasks",
    "Errored tasks",
    "Expected held-out predictions if all fits succeed",
    "Stored held-out predictions"
  ),
  Value = c(
    75L,
    nrow(results),
    sum(results$Status == "ok"),
    sum(results$Status == "error"),
    75L * 39L,
    nrow(predictions)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

result_structure |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    caption = "Stored real-data GBLUP-ADE result structure",
    row.names = FALSE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-hover table-bordered"'
  )
```

A task with `Status = "ok"` returned 39 finite held-out predictions. This status
does not by itself constitute a formal numerical-convergence diagnostic for the
variance-component optimizer.

### 10.1 Performance by trait

```{r performance-summary}
ok_results <- results[
  results$Status == "ok",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (nrow(ok_results) == 0L) {
  stop("No successful GBLUP-ADE tasks are available.")
}

trait_performance <- aggregate(
  cbind(
    Phenotype_Correlation,
    Phenotype_RMSE,
    Phenotype_MAE,
    Phenotype_Bias,
    Phenotype_Slope,
    Phenotype_R2
  ) ~ Trait,
  data = ok_results,
  FUN = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

trait_performance <- trait_performance[
  match(
    traits,
    trait_performance$Trait
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

trait_performance |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    digits = 4,
    caption = "Mean held-out GBLUP-ADE performance across the 25 outer splits",
    row.names = FALSE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-hover table-bordered"'
  )
```

### 10.2 Split-level variability

```{r split-summary}
split_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    split(
      ok_results,
      ok_results$Trait
    ),
    function(x) {
      data.frame(
        Trait = unique(x$Trait),
        N = nrow(x),
        Cor_mean = mean(
          x$Phenotype_Correlation,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        Cor_sd = sd(
          x$Phenotype_Correlation,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        Cor_min = min(
          x$Phenotype_Correlation,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        Cor_max = max(
          x$Phenotype_Correlation,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        RMSE_mean = mean(
          x$Phenotype_RMSE,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        RMSE_sd = sd(
          x$Phenotype_RMSE,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        MAE_mean = mean(
          x$Phenotype_MAE,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        Bias_mean = mean(
          x$Phenotype_Bias,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        Slope_mean = mean(
          x$Phenotype_Slope,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        R2_mean = mean(
          x$Phenotype_R2,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
)

rownames(split_summary) <- NULL

split_summary <- split_summary[
  match(
    traits,
    split_summary$Trait
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

split_summary |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    digits = 4,
    caption = "GBLUP-ADE variability across the 25 outer splits",
    row.names = FALSE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-hover table-bordered"'
  )
```

## 11. Held-out performance figures

```{r correlation-figure, fig.cap="Held-out phenotype correlation for GBLUP-ADE across the 25 family-stratified outer splits. White diamonds indicate trait means."}
p_correlation <- ggplot(
  ok_results,
  aes(
    x = Trait,
    y = Phenotype_Correlation,
    fill = Trait
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.58,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.70
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.10,
      height = 0,
      seed = SEED_GLOBAL + 301L
    ),
    alpha = 0.45,
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 23,
    size = 3.2,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gdocs() +
  labs(
    x = "Trait",
    y = "Held-out Pearson correlation",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_gdocs() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_correlation)
```

## 12. Computational record

```{r time-summary}
time_summary <- aggregate(
  cbind(
    Fit_seconds,
    Predict_seconds
  ) ~ Trait,
  data = ok_results,
  FUN = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

time_summary$Kernel_build_seconds <-
  run_metadata$kernel_build_seconds

time_summary |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    digits = 3,
    caption = "GBLUP-ADE computational record",
    row.names = FALSE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-hover table-bordered"'
  )

cat(
  "Total run time:",
  round(
    run_metadata$total_run_seconds,
    2
  ),
  "seconds.\n"
)
```

Kernel construction is a one-time cost reused by all three traits and all 25
outer splits.

## 13. Frozen R06 contract

The primary real-data GBLUP benchmark is defined by:

- 195 individuals;
- the common 20,887-marker panel;
- three prepared phenotype targets: `Prod.Cor`, `Cer`, and `BM`;
- 5 repetitions x 5 family-stratified outer folds;
- 156 analysis and 39 assessment individuals per split;
- one additive, one dominance, and one additive-by-additive epistatic genomic
  component;
- no use of outer-assessment phenotype during fitting;
- one common set of held-out predictions later reused for model comparison.

The ANN branch must use the same 25 outer splits. Hyperparameter selection must
remain restricted to the nested inner folds stored in
`real_cv_design.rds`.
